items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: So and then Taps -- I told Taps, now, anything Glenn does, I gives him 50 percent of the original because his name was big. So it's better to let him have 50 percent of your song

ctx.x: Well, here's the way it was. Taps Miller had the lyrics. He went to Basie, Basie wouldn't do them because they was all out of meter and he didn't have the meters, he couldn't fit the words with the music.
